label: Special economic zones
source: UNCTAD, World Investment Report 2019: Special Economic Zones (chapter IV, tables IV.2-IV.3, and web annex table 21 'The universe of SEZs')
method: Number of special economic zones per economy from UNCTAD's World Investment Report 2019 inventory (5,383 zones in 147 economies), counted by establishment under law and excluding 8,368 single-enterprise 'free points'; UNCTAD compiled the data from public sources and national institutions and verified them with governments where possible, so counts are as reported by governments. Economies shown as 0 were examined and had no counted zone; economies marked '..' (no information) in the source are left out. Abbreviations as in the source: EZ economic zone, EPZ export processing zone, FTZ free trade zone, FZ free zone. Kosovo uses the code XKX.
